summary: TNL Mediagene filed a 6-K disclosing a September 30, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement to sell its wholly owned Japanese holding company (Mediagene Inc. and Infobahn Inc.) to MI Company Inc., an acquisition vehicle for an investor group led by CEO Motoko Imada. Aggregate consideration is $5.5 million, subject to net intercompany debt adjustment from a $612,064 reference and set-off, each capped at $500,000. At closing the buyer must pay or satisfy at least $4.5 million, including at least $2.5 million cash, with the remainder evidenced by a secured promissory note maturing December 31, 2026, secured by a first-priority pledge of at least 55% of buyer shares held by Imada. A special committee of disinterested directors, advised by Greenberg Traurig and Imperial Capital, negotiated the deal; Imperial Capital rendered a fairness opinion. Watch the short maturity of the seller note, the tight pledge overhang, and related-party governance risk, including possible minority-shareholder challenges to process and price.
